Dar Saha

A boutique Lebanese guesthouse

Build a small hospitality brand around the feeling of arriving somewhere unhurried. Connect the courtyard-inspired identity, guest stationery, room discovery and a simple stay-planning journey.

Explore the live demo ↗Download the project kit
The audience

Weekend travellers, couples and Lebanese visitors looking for a thoughtful short escape.

The scope

Brand strategy, bilingual identity, packaging, website and launch campaign.

Project status

Fictional brand. Original concept work by Digits Studio.

A feeling, made recognisable.

An open courtyard and an arched doorway form the symbol. Cobalt comes from shutters and glazed tiles; chalk and honey stone bring warmth. Spacious serif lettering gives the guesthouse an inviting, quietly established voice.

Stay for the slower part.

A hospitality launch that introduces a feeling before a room: the courtyard, the morning light and the small rituals of a weekend away. Room discovery and a welcome email provide the next step.

Proposed launch campaign / no performance results claimed

A four-week rollout

  1. Week 1Introduce the courtyard feelingTerrace post / identity story
  2. Week 2Explore the roomsRoom creative / room-detail page
  3. Week 3Imagine a slower weekendStay-planning creative / welcome email
  4. Week 4Return to the morning ritualEditorial story / reminder creative

What we would measure

Room-detail views, stay-plan completions and return visits. These are proposed measures; there are no real bookings or campaign results.
